services.name: Move-in rekeys
services.blurb: Every outside lock on one new key before the movers unload, including garage and side doors.

services.name: Locked out of the house
services.blurb: Range said on the phone, ID checked on the porch, door picked open, not drilled.

services.name: Sticking deadbolts
services.blurb: Strike moved and door adjusted so the bolt throws in the wet months too.

services.name: Rental turnovers
services.blurb: Rentals rekeyed between tenants, keys tagged, and a key list left for the owner.

services.name: Deadbolts and smart locks
services.blurb: Deadbolts or keypad locks fitted, codes set with you, old codes cleared.

services.name: Old house hardware
services.blurb: Glass knobs and old mortise locks kept on the door and made to work again.

services.name: Car lockouts
services.blurb: Car doors opened with soft wedges and reach tools; basic key copies cut in the van.

services.name: Key copies
services.blurb: House and mailbox keys cut and tried in your lock so nothing sticks later.

reviews.text: We got PCS orders and closed on a house in Lakewood two days before the truck came. They rekeyed six locks the morning we got the keys, so the movers only ever had our new ones.
reviews.name: Keisha R.

reviews.text: Every November our front deadbolt stops lining up. He moved the strike plate, planed a sliver off the door and showed me why it happens. Locks easily now, even after a week of rain.
reviews.name: Doug H.

reviews.text: Our Stadium District house still has the original glass knobs. Another company wanted to replace everything. Many Doors fixed the old latches and kept the look.
reviews.name: Claire V.

reviews.text: Three rentals in Puyallup and Fife. Turnovers get rekeyed fast, the keys come back tagged, and the price is the same range every time. That makes my life simpler.
reviews.name: Raj P.

reviews.text: Locked out in the rain with the baby asleep inside. They told me the price range, texted the tech's name and van, and checked my ID before opening. Fifteen calm minutes on the porch.
reviews.name: Jenna L.

reviews.text: Keys locked in the car at the Steilacoom ferry lot. Opened it without a scratch and was gone before my coffee got cold.
reviews.name: Mike O.
